column1: # Spread-required residue (#27): a PEER-introduced map key whose value
# cannot generate on its own — most commonly a spread template field
# applied to a child that never receives a concrete value — is
# DISTINGUISHED residue: the registered mapval_spread_required code
# (class incomplete), not the generic *_no_gen. The machinery is TS's
# ExpectVal (ts/src/val/ExpectVal.ts), ported as go/expect.go: the
# expectation escapes to a real value the moment a concrete peer
# arrives, and an optional child drops its unmet expectations wholesale.
# Every expectation below was probed byte-identical in BOTH engines at
# promotion time (full error text included).
